rootCause: The generated Gradle manifest scanner used raw lastIndexOf('}') as a Java member boundary. A Spring path template such as /{id} therefore truncated the current annotation prefix after the mapping and produced a false missing-mapping failure.
fix: Bound each operation annotation prefix by the class body or previous CpfOnlineTransaction annotation.
Apply the canonical generator repair to current Member, External, and prebuilt Backoffice generated build entrypoints.
Add a setup regression that requires a /{id} sample path and rejects the raw-brace boundary implementation.
